name: stellary
description: Connect Cursor to Stellary, the AI-native project piloting SaaS, through the hosted Streamable HTTP MCP server. Discover projects, boards, documents, cockpit state, and governed agent missions using a Bearer personal access token.

STELLARY_TOKEN.title: Stellary token
STELLARY_TOKEN.description: Personal access token from Stellary Account settings → API tokens. Sent as Authorization: Bearer ${STELLARY_TOKEN} to https://api.stellary.co/mcp. This plugin wraps the hosted remote MCP; it does not start a local stdio process or use OAuth.
